name: 72201 · Little Rock, AR
findings: ZIP 72201 (Little Rock) has 238 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 95 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72201 (Little Rock) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72201 (Little Rock) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 114.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 95 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
